history: A focused lock draft expected the word locked while the existing shared command error says Unlock this layer and its parent groups first; the final test asserts that actual error for both owner and child mutations. The full draft was interrupted before correcting the assertion, then the focused 18-case protection suite passed before the final build and freeze.

Final browser coverage explicitly combines 127 unchanged passing cases from stage one, 220 from stage two, all 24 PSB cases in stage three and all 24 group cases in stage four.
